title: Atlas DataFlow Training Parameter Record
description: Schema for the training-parameter-record.json artifact emitted by a governed M24 training run. The record is a reduced provenance artifact written under pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/training-parameter-record.json. It links the consumed execution contract and prepared dataset to the produced model and metrics artifacts using SHA-256 hashes. It is distinct from metrics.json and must not embed raw dataset contents, model bytes, raw logs, raw runtime data, raw API payloads, secrets, or notebook state.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the training parameter record artifact.

record_kind.description: Identifies this artifact as the provenance and parameter record for a governed training run, not as the training metrics artifact.

training_run_identity.description: Identity of the training run that produced this record.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset slug used to parameterize the training run path.

run_id.description: Training run identifier using the train-{timestamp}Z convention.

output_directory.description: Concrete output directory for this run, derived from pipeline/training-runs/{dataset_slug}/{run_id}/.

consumed_inputs.description: Reduced references to the governed training inputs. The dataset_id values must match before training proceeds.

execution_contract_path.description: Explicit path reference to the execution_contract.v1 JSON consumed by the training entrypoint.

dataset_path.description: Explicit path reference to the prepared dataset consumed by the training entrypoint.

execution_contract_dataset_id.description: dataset_id read from the execution contract.

prepared_dataset_dataset_id.description: dataset_id read from the prepared dataset metadata. Must match execution_contract_dataset_id.

produced_outputs.description: Reduced path references to artifacts produced by the same training run. The metrics artifact is distinct from this parameter record.

serialized_model_path.description: Path to the serialized model artifact. The default interface convention is model.pkl, but the role remains stable if a future serializer changes the extension.

metrics_path.description: Path to the distinct training metrics artifact.

model_selection_evidence_path.description: Path to conditional model selection evidence. Null when no multi-candidate comparison was performed.

model_card_input_path.description: Path to reduced model card input data produced for downstream M24 model-card work.

permitted_execution_contract_fields.description: Closed list of execution contract fields actually consumed by the training run. Must match the M24 training interface subset and must not include ignored_columns, required_columns, or optional_columns.

training_parameters.description: Reduced parameter values selected from the permitted execution contract fields for reproducibility and audit. This record intentionally does not include ignored_columns, required_columns, or optional_columns.

hashes.description: SHA-256 hashes linking the consumed inputs and produced outputs for this training run.

execution_contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the execution contract JSON file consumed.

prepared_dataset_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the prepared dataset file consumed.

model_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the serialized model artifact produced.

metrics_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the metrics.json artifact produced.

record_boundary_confirmations.description: Boundary confirmations for the parameter record artifact.

is_metrics_artifact.description: This parameter record is not the metrics artifact.

unauthorized_contract_fields_consumed.description: No execution contract fields outside the permitted M24 training subset were consumed.

evidence_policy.description: Safety policy for the training parameter record.
